minimax-ppio.description: PPIO MiniMax music and speech generation.
notes: Keep the original authored emotion in asset_directions[].emotion.
Keep delivery nuance in asset_directions[].tone when available.
Map the combined authored emotion/tone intent into provider_bindings.minimax-ppio.voice_emotion.
Use project-local voice_profile.* ids for character casting unless a run intentionally supplies concrete MiniMax voice ids.
